Commentary.Commentary: UPDATE 1930 LOCAL TIME - The news from the centre is that we have a game on our hands and it's going to be a 47-over chase with a target of 231 for India. The game is scheduled to resume at 2000 LOCAL.
UPDATE 1918 LOCAL TIME - The covers are coming off as the rain has stopped. Stay tuned for further updates.

1845 LOCAL TIME - Bad news folks, the second innings was scheduled to begin by now but it has started raining heavily. The cut-off time for a 20-over match is 2155 LOCAL TIME, post which there will be no further play today. However, there is a reserve day tomorrow so in case we don't finish the game by 2315 LOCAL TIME, the remaining overs can be completed tomorrow. Just to let you guys know, the reserve day applies for all the remaining games as well.

Bumrah was the main man with the ball and he finished with figures of 10-2-43-4. The rest of the bowlers also did their job well. Chahal picked up two wickets while Pandya and Patel chipped in with one apiece. India look favourites to win this one as well but stranger things have happened in cricket. The pitch is expected to be better for batting in the second innings so the run-chase should be easy for the visitors. Stay tuned for the run-chase after the break.

India will be happy with the way they restricted Sri Lanka. However, there are a few causes of concern. First they leaked 22 runs as extras which included 11 wides. Also, Hardik Pandya pulled out with a muscle injury and it will be interesting to see if he is deemed fit enough to bat. Hopefully for India, it is nothing too serious and the all-rounder will be ready if required.

Siriwardana and Kapugedera were the two who steadied the ship and ensured Sri Lanka cross the 200-run mark with a 91-run stand. The former even got to his 3rd ODI fifty on his comeback. However, they could not go on till the end as Bumrah was once again sensational at the death as he conceded only 14 runs in three overs with 3 scalps.

Sri Lanka will be pleased with the total on the board after suffering a bit of a collapse in the middle overs. The openers started cautiously. They both got starts with Dickwella really looking good with his shots. However, the onslaught was stopped as Bumrah picked the first of his four wickets in the form of the Lankan keeper. The spinners then came in and kept it tight.

Dug in short on middle, Chameera uses his feet and swings hard at it across the line. Ends up missing it completely. Dhoni fumbles and the batsmen set off to sneak in a bye. The keeper doesn't recover in time and a run is taken. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 236/8.
Well bowled! Slower one outside off, Chameera looks to tap it square of the wicket on the off side but misses.
Fernando backs away and Kumar keeps it full. Driven through mid on for a run.
Good thinking by Kumar! He bowls this one short after bowling two full length deliveries. Vishwa goes for the pull but misses.
Very full and tailing in on middle. Chameera plays it to square leg where Chahal dives to his right to stop it. Keeps it to a single.
Yorker on the boots, Fernando looks to dig it out but gets an inside edge to fine leg for a run.
Fullish delivery, jammed to mid off for a quick run. Brilliant spell from Bumrah. He has been right on the money once again in the death overs. He finishes with figures of 10-2-43-4.
Slower delivery outside off, Fernando is completely foxed by it as he late to play a shot.
Fuller on off, hit hard to the bowler.
Short delivery, pulled to the leg side for a run.
Vishwa Fernando comes out to bat.

OUT! Bumrah gets a 4-fer! He has varied his pace nicely and gets rewarded again. Bowls a slower one on a length on middle, Dananjaya makes room and tries to go big over mid-wicket but miscues it completely. The ball spoons in the air behind the bowler. Patel moves to his left from mid off and takes it easily.
FOUR! Shot! Short delivery in line of the stumps, Dananjaya makes room and drags his pull over mid-wicket to find the fence.
Short delivery, Dushmantha goes for the hook but fails to make any contact
Slower one outside off, Chameera swipes it off the inner half through square leg. Two runs taken.
Fullish delivery, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
On the pads, nudged to fine leg for a run.
Fullish delivery, driven hard to mid off.
Shortish delivery, Akila swings but misses.
Dushmantha Chameera comes in to bat.

OUT! Bumrah special this time! A typical yorker from the death-over specialist does Kapugedera in. He looked to dig it out but could not get his bat down in time. Sri Lanka have started losing wickets again! It is a crucial time of the game and they really would not have wanted this.
Full length this time. It has been played off the front foot and into the ground.

Shortish ball and Danajaya looks for the pull. The ball goes off the toe-end of the bat towards mid off. Dananjaya sets off for the single. Axar Patel makes a good stop and has a shy at the non-striker's end. A direct hit would have gotten him as Danajaya was nowhere near the crease. Lucky run for Sri Lanka.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.

The decision remains! The ball was a yorker on middle and Kapugedera looked to defend it but got an inside edge onto the pads. Kohli went for the review when the umpire said not out for the lbw appeal. Replays confirmed there was an inside edge there.
Virat Kohli takes a review for an lbw decision. The review is left so he wants to use it.
Back of a length, Danajaya rocks onto the back foot and punches his away for a single.
Outside off yet again, Danajaya opens the face of his bat and gets a single at third man.
Wide outside off yet again. This time Kapugedera plays a square drive but only gets a single. That was a great stop by the fielder.
Wide. The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. The Umpire signals a wide.
The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely.

In the air and dropped! Yuzvendra Chahal what have you done! The ball was full on off and Kapugedera went across the line looking for a biggie over deep mid-wicket. Yuzvendra Chahal did the hard work of getting there but failed to keep the ball in his hands. The ball was going towards the ropes but Chahal dived and stopped it from crossing the ropes at the last moment. The umpire wanted to check if he had touched the ropes during contact with the ball but replays showed that it was a clean save. Two runs taken in the end.
Slightly fuller on the pads. It has been nudged towards square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle. Tapped into the ground towards short cover.
Akila Dananjaya comes out to bat.

OUT! The slog-overs specialist strikes! Bumrah steams in and bowls a slower ball on off. It's on a length and Siriwardana backs away to shape for a big hit. He intends to flat-bat it over mid off but only manages to slice it off the outer half of his bat towards extra cover. Rohit Sharma stationed there doesn't need to move an inch and pouches it safely. A very good knock from Milinda comes to an end and also the 91-run stand.
Kapugedera backs away and Bumrah follows him. Tapped to the right of Pandya at short third man. He dives to make a half-stop. A run taken. The ball is following Pandya.
Played through mid-wicket by Siriwardana. One run added to the total. Pandya is walking across gingerly. He is struggling with his left knee.
Good length delivery outside off, placed towards the short third man fielder for a run.
Fullish delivery around off, Siriwardana eases it towards extra cover. Another well-judged run.
Slower delivery outside off, Chamara taps it to short third man for a brisk run.
Jasprit Bumrah is back for his final spell. Can he break this flourishing partnership?
Stays back and defends this one.
In the air... but safe! Fullish on middle, Kapugedera mistimes his slog towards deep mid-wicket. Thankfully for him, it lands short of the fielder. A run taken.
Tossed up ball, drilled back towards the bowler.
Three wides! Down the leg side, Chamara goes for a sweep but misses. Dhoni also fails to collect it. Two runs taken and a wide is signalled.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Fullish one, swept around the corner for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Tossed up around off, Kapugedera goes for a booming drive but gets a thick outside edge. Dhoni gets wrong footed and as a result, gets beaten. The ball rolls to the third man fence as there is no protection in the deep.
Uses his feet again and looks to turn it to the leg side but gets a leading edge through mid off. Pandya misfields but keeps it to a single.
Well outside off, drilled to sweeper cover for a run.
Uses his feet and milks it to long off for a run.
Tossed up delivery, Milinda lifts it over extra cover. Two runs taken.
Short delivery, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Chahal to bowl his final over now.
Shorter one outside off, Kapugedera punches it to long off for a run.
3rd ODI fifty for Milinda Siriwardana. He has made his return to the Sri Lankan side count. It's been a well-measured innings.

Shortish outside off, Siriwardana cuts it to cover-point. The fielder makes a mess of it and the batsmen take a quick run. A wayward throw at the keeper's end results in two overthrows. It has been a good half century from Milinda after his comeback into the Sri Lankan side. He needs to carry on.
Outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Shorter delivery, punched off the back foot for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Starts off with a half-tracker. Siriwardana kneels and pulls it over wide mid on. Rahul hares to his left from long on, slides near the fence and does well to save the boundary. Two runs taken.
Yuzvendra Chahal was ready to bowl his final over but Kedar Jadhav has been brought on by Virat Kohli.
Fullish this time, Milinda knocks it down to long on for a run. A brilliant spell from Patel. He ends with figures of 10-0-30-1.
Tossed up delivery, the southpaw lunges forward in defense.
Straighter one outside off, Siriwardana looks to dab it late but gets beaten.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Loopy delivery, driven crisply through covers for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled by the umpire. Five fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Outside off, tapped to point.
Kapugedera looks to sweep this one but is struck on the pads. The ball rolls to the leg side. Two leg byes taken.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Milinda makes room, uses his feet and lifts it over extra cover. A couple taken.
Fullish delivery, knocked to long off for a run.
Tossed up delivery, Kapugedera drives it with an open face through point. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and keeps it down to a couple.
50-run stand up between Kapugedera and Siriwardana. This is the first fifty run stand of the Sri Lankan innings. The duo needs to carry on to post a decent total on the board.
Loopy delivery, Chamara eases it past Patel to take a single and will retain the strike.
Turned to mid-wicket this time with the angle.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, Kapugedera looks to push it to covers but gets it off the inner half down the track. The ball hits the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Shorter one around off, tapped to covers.
Arm ball sliding down leg, Chamara looks to clip it but is hit on the pads.
Flatter around off, Kapugedera punches it to the left side of Chahal. He dives full length to his left but fails to stop the single.
Slower through the air on middle and leg, the right-hander lunges forward in defense.
Landed on off, stays low. Milinda adjusts and punches it through wide mid off for a run.
Loopy ball around off, eased to short extra cover.
Straighter one on off, Chamara hangs on the back foot and knocks it past the short extra cover fielder. A run taken.
Around the pads, nudged to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Yuzvendra Chahal to roll his arm again.
A bit shorter outside off, punched off the back foot to cover-point.
Places this one to point for a quick single.
Wide outside off, Milinda looks to dab it late but misses.
Flighted delivery, turned to the leg side.
Flighted delivery, swept behind square on the leg side for a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Axar Patel is back on.

SIX! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short delivery, doesn't bounce much. Siriwardana rocks back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket. It sails over the fence. The ball boy near the ropes takes a good catch.
Loopy delivery, pushed to covers.
Outside off, Chamara punches it to sweeper cover for a couple.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Floated delivery, defended off the front foot down the track.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Fullish delivery on off, played with soft hands back to the bowler.
Good length delivery well outside off, Kapugedera dabs it neatly towards third man. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and stops it well. Two runs taken.
Dug in short around off, Chamara sways away from the line of the delivery.
Kumar rolls his fingers on this one and bowls it on a fuller length outside off. Milinda is early into his push and as a result, gets it off the inner half to the leg side. A run taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kapugedera dabs it to the right side of the keeper for a quick run.
On a length on off, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single. 150 up for Sri Lanka and it is met with a cheer from the crowd.

Time for Drinks. India have continued to chip away at the wickets through some disciplined bowling. This is the last recognized batting pair for Sri Lanka and they need to build up a substantial stand.
Fullish delivery, eased through mid off for a run.
Short delivery outside off, Siriwardana cuts it through point for a couple.
Leg bye! Around the pads, Kapugedera goes for the sweep but is struck on the pads as the ball rolls to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Well outside off, Milinda lets it go.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, played to point.
Kedar Jadhav comes on to bowl.
On off this time, Kapugedera plays it straight to point.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery to defend this one.
Good length ball on off and Kapugedera looks to push at it. The ball takes an inside edge and goes off his pads towards backward square leg.
On the pads this time. Siriwardana flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Good length ball on middle. Siriwardana plays it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Wide! The bouncer is way too high to be called a legit delivery. Siriwardana ducked under it.

FOUR! Slightly short on off and Siriwardana pulls it hard over mid-wicket. The ball goes in the air and bounces on its way towards the ropes. Sri Lanka need more of this from their batsmen in the middle.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes back to bowl.
Outside off again, played to point once again.
Good length outside off. Kapugedera plays it through point for a couple.

FOUR! The short ball has been dispatched by Kapugedera. He gets right in the position to pull it hard and flat over mid-wicket for a boundary. The cameraman almost got hit by the ball as it narrowly missed him. That would have surely hurt him had the ball hit him.
Slightly fuller on off. Pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Bowls this one outside off. Played to point this time.
Bouncer and Kapugedera goes for the pull as he takes his eyes off the ball. The ball goes over his bat and there is a slight appeal. Nothing to it.
Flighted on middle, Siriwardana defends it from within the crease.
Floated on off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery to defend this one.
Outside off once again, Siriwardana plays it towards point for a single.
Slower through the air on the off side. Siriwardana looked to play it over mid-wicket and got it off the inside half of the bat as the ball went towards mid-wicket.
Flighted on middle and leg. It has been nudged to the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, Kapugedara drives it straight to mid on.
Floated on middle, defended off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish on the pads, Kapugedera flicks it through mid-wicket as Chahal gives the chase. He misfields as he can't collect the ball in his first attempt. Two runs have been added to the total.
Another good length ball outside off, it has been played straight to point.
Good length ball. The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bumrah has been brought back on.
Outside off this time. Siriwardana plays it to the point region.
Floated on middle, it has been driven to mid on for a single.
Wide. The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The Umpire signals a wide.
Floated on middle, defended off the back foot.
Chamara Kapugedera walks in to bat next.

OUT! Axar strikes this time! It is the big wicket of Angelo Mathews. He couldn't take the review as it was already used. The ball was on off and it came on with the arm, Mathews went for the sweep but missed the ball completely. The ball struck him low on the pads and Axar appealed straightaway. The umpire had a thought and raised his finger in the end. Sri Lanka are in deep trouble with half the side back in the hut.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Floated on off, played off the front foot and into the ground.
On off, Siriwardana drives it through covers for a single to end the over.
Flighted on middle once again. Siriwardana rocks to his back foot and punches the ball to covers.
Floated on middle again, driven through mid on for a single.
Floated this on middle and leg. Mathews comes down and flicks it to mid-wicket.

Pandya is uncomfortable and he has a chat with Kohli. He is going off the field now. India will hope that it is not a serious injury as Hardik is really vital to India's cause. Meanwhile, Kedar Jadhav will complete the over.
Fullish on off, defended solidly by Mathews.
Pandya is struggling with his left knee. The physio attends him.
FOUR! Not off the meat of the bat but good enough! Good length delivery around off, Mathews dances down the track and drags his heave through mid-wicket to find the fence.
Hardik Pandya is back on.
Well played! Siriwardana paddle sweeps it to fine leg for a couple.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Floated delivery, eased through mid off for a run.
Tossed up delivery, pushed back towards the bowler.
Flatter delivery on off, kept out off the back foot.
Shortish delivery, cut towards point.
Flighted on the leg stump. Mathews flicks it towards mid-wicket for another single.
Floated on middle, Siriwardana nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Similar ball, driven straight to mid off.
Floated on off, Mathews drives it through mid off for a single.
On the pads, it has been flicked away but straight to the fielder at square leg.
Full on off, driven superbly through the covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bowls this one outside off, it has been played straight to point for a single.
Shows the full face of the bat to this one off the back foot.
FOUR! Air given outside off this time. Siriwardana waits and opens the face of the bat at the last moment to guide it past third man for a boundary.
Floated on off this time, it has been pushed to covers for a single.
Flighted on middle, defended off the back foot by Mathews.
Flighted on middle this time. Mathews drives it to mid on.
Floated on off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Floated on off, Siriwardana drives it to covers.
Milinda Siriwardana is the new man in.

OUT! The decision stays! It looked like a hopeful review rather than anything. The ball was floated on middle and off and it went in with the angle. Mendis went for the sweep but missed it as the ball struck him on the pads. The Indians were confident with the appeal as the umpire raised his finger. Mendis had other ideas as he consulted Mathews before going for the review. The Ultra Edge did not spot anything. Hawk Eye showed that the impact was on middle and it would have gone on to hit the middle stump as well. Sri Lanka lose their fourth wicket and are surely in trouble now.
Mendis has taken a review against an lbw decision. Looks plumb to the naked eye.
Floated on off this time, it has been driven through covers.
Floated on middle, it has been driven straight to mid on.
Outside off again, played straight to the man at point.
Long on in place now for Mathews.
Sweeps this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Again outside off from Patel. Mendis cuts it towards point.
Floated on middle. It has been defended solidly off the back foot.
Wide. This was very wide outside off. Umpire signals wide.
Outside off, played straight to point this time.
Floated on middle, punched off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Floated on off, driven towards covers.
Rocks onto his back foot and punches this down to long on for a single.
Floated on off, played off the front foot and into the ground.
On off this time, defended to the off side by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted on middle this time. Mendis sweeps it nicely through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, driven straight to covers.
Spin from both ends. Chahal comes back on to bowl.
Flighted on the pads. Mendis flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Floated on off this time. Mendis drives it through covers for a couple.
Loopy delivery on middle. Mathews drives it through mid on for a single.
Full on off, defended off the front foot solidly.
Flighted on middle, Mathews defends it by pushing the ball towards the man at covers.
Floated on off and middle, played straight back to Axar.
On the pads this time, Mathews flicks it behind square leg for a single.

FOUR! A classic shot from Mathews! The ball was full on off and the former Sri lankan skipper stayed in his crease before timing it off his front foot past the bowler. The ball raced away through mid on and to the boundary.
Good length this time, defended off the back foot.
Slightly on the fuller length and the bounce was low. The ball goes to the man at covers off a leading edge as Mathews looked to defend by closing the face of the bat.
Action replay of the last ball as he again pulls it straight to the same fielder.
Shortish ball outside off. Mathews plays a good looking pull but straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Floated on middle and off again. Defended off the front foot solidly by Mendis. Axar starts off with a maiden!
Floated on off, defended off the front foot.
Floated on off, played past the bowler for a single. Patel did his best with a diving effort to stop the ball but it went in vain.
Flighted wide outside off. Mathews looks to cut but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball on off, played back to the bowler.
Axar Patel comes on to bowl.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to point for a single.
Another short delivery, Angelo sits under the bumper.
Good length delivery, defended solidly off the back foot.
That one took off! Back of a length around off, shoots off after pitching. Mathews is surprised by the extra bounce and fends it off.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman
Short delivery on middle, Mathews ducks under it.
Outside off this time, played towards point.
Floated on off, played off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat
Outside off this time, played towards point.

Two leg byes! Floated around the pads, Mendis looked for the sweep but missed. The ball strikes him on the pads and there is a loud shout for lbw. However, it pitched outside leg and the umpire was not interested. Meanwhile the batsmen picked up a couple of leg byes as the ball went towards fine leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Time for Drinks. Angelo Mathews will walk in next.

OUT! Tharanga departs and it's another failure for the skipper! The ball was slightly fuller than a good length and the batsman looked to push it with an angled bat to third man. It was a nothing shot really and the ball took an outside edge which carried to Virat Kohli at wide first slip. The Indian skipper kept his eyes on the ball and made no mistake to remove his counterpart. Superb start by India as they keep on taking wickets on a regular basis.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Slightly on the shorter side, defended off the back foot.
Bowls this one outside off, Mendis guides it towards third man for a single.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery to defend this one.
Outside off played straight to point.
Flighted on the pads, flicked down the leg side for a single to end the over.
Floated on off, driven through covers for a single.

FOUR! Another boundary for Tharanga! This time he guides the ball towards third man as he uses the pace of the bowler. The captain will have to play a good long innings if he wants to see his team post a good total.
Floated outside off and Tharanga looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge there but does not carry to the fielder at slip.
FOUR! Starts off with a boundary straightaway. The ball was loopy on off and Tharanga moved to his front foot and pushed it through covers for a boundary.
Upul Tharanga is the new man in.

OUT! Chahal gets his first wicket! Gunathalika has been removed and he only has himself to blame there. He came down the ground looking to push it but Chahal gave the ball air and it completely bamboozled the batsman. Gunathalika missed the ball completely as it went towards Dhoni. The keeper fumbled as he was blinded by it but stayed as calm as ever to complete the stumping. Gunathilaka was stranded out of his crease and had to walk back just like his opening partner did before him. This is also Dhoni's 99th ODI stumping!
Another one that has been defended off the front foot.
Full on off, played off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Top shot from Mendis! Pandya bowls it slightly short and Mendis gets behind the bounce to cut it past the backward point region for a boundary. The ball raced away there!
Good length on middle, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Mendis gets lucky this time. The ball was on a length and just outside off. Mendis looked to open the face of the bat and play it behind but only managed to get an outside edge. He played it with soft hands and the ball bounced past the keeper for a boundary at third man.
Short ball angling in towards Gunathilaka. It has been worked down the leg side towards fine leg for a single.
Wide. Starts off with a bouncer yet again. The ball goes high over the batsman and it has been called a wide.
Given width this time, Mendis cuts it towards point.
Floated on middle, driven towards mid on this time.
On middle this time, Mendis gets to his front foot and taps it into the ground.
Flighted on middle, played straight to mid-wicket.
Slip comes in for the right-hander.
Loopy ball on off, tapped gently into the ground towards the off side for a quick single.
Floated on middle, played straight back to the bowler.
Full on off, played off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish on the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Good length outside off, Gunathilaka plays it straight to point.
Wide! Short ball once again. The umpire calls it wide this time.
Fullish on the pads this time, Mendis flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Bowls this one wide outside off. Mendis plays it straight to point.
Starts off with a bouncer. Mendis leaves it alone.
Hardik Pandya comes on to bowl.
Punched off the back foot once again by Gunathilaka. Good start by Chahal.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot through covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dances down the track and pushes this towards long on for a single.
Floated on off. Mendis plays it with a straight bat past the bowler for a single at mid off.
Loopy ball on the pads, Gunathilaka nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal comes on to bowl as spin is introduced for the first time.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now four fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Fullish delivery, eased back towards the bowler.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Slower delivery outside off, Mendis looks to defend it but gets a slight edge on it and the ball rolls to the keeper. The Snicko confirms the edge.
Outside off, placed to point.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, the southpaw places it past Bumrah at short fine leg to find the fence.
On a length on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Four Leg Byes! Straying on the pads, Gunathilaka looks to clip it away but the ball brushes his pads. Bumrah at short fine leg dives but the ball goes past him in a flash and through to the fence.
Wide! Sprays this one down the leg side, Danushka looks to play it across but misses.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Leg bye! On the pads, Gunathilaka looks to play but misses and the ball brushes off his pads towards fine leg. Leg bye taken.
Artificial lights have been turned on.
Full on middle and off, played off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish on the pads this time, Mendis works it down the leg side towards square leg.
Good length ball on middle, played straight to mid-wicket.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! Bumrah strikes and it is Dickwella who has to go! Smart bowling there as he followed Niroshan who was backing away to the leg side. Bumrah bowled the ball full on the pads and the wicket-keeper batsman tried to get his bat behind it. He only managed to chip the ball to Dhawan at short mid-wicket. The Indian opener was alert and he jumped and grabbed it with both hands before taking a roll as he went down with a smile. India will be happy to break this dangerous looking partnership!
On the pads, defended off the back foot this time.

Shortish ball but on the slower side. Dickwella looks for the pull but is too early on it and misses the ball completely. Meanwhile Hardik Pandya gets some treatment from the physio as his dive in the previous over might have injured his arm.
Full on the pads this time, Gunathilaka flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Dickwella moves towards the ball and defends it towards point.
Back of a length, punched off the back foot.
On the pads this time, it has been flicked away to the leg side.
Good length ball in the line of the stumps. Dickwella defends it off the back foot.
Outside off this time, Dickwella plays it straight to point.

FOUR! Superb timing from Dickwella as he finds the gap through covers. The ball was on a back of a length and Dickwella stayed on his back foot and got it off the middle of the bat. The dive by Shikhar Dhawan was not good enough to save the boundary.
Full on off, it has been pushed towards covers for a single.
Change of bat for Dickwella, the yorker must have been too good to the toe end of the willow.
Yorker from Bumrah, Dickwella does well to dig it out.

SIX! This time Dickwella makes no mistake! Bumrah went for the short ball again but immediately must have regretted it. Dickwella got into the position and powered it over backward square leg for a biggie.
Short ball this time. Gunathilaka looks for the pull but does not get the right connection. Nevertheless gets enough behind it to pick a single to fine leg.
Once again bowled outside off. Played straight to point once again.
On a good length outside off. Gunathilaka plays it straight to point.
Dickwella defends this good length ball from within the crease.
Full on off, Dickwella pushes it towards covers.
Another one wide outside off. Gunathilaka cuts it past point for a single.
Outside off this time, Gunathilaka plays it straight to point.
Once again on the same line. This time Dickwella works it past Chahal at backward square leg for another single.
Fullish on the pads and slightly slower. Gunathilaka flicks it past the backward square leg region for a single.
On the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery to defend this one.
Full on middle and off, defended off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length ball this time, punched off the back foot to the off side for a single.

SIX! Follows it up with a biggie! That was a shorter length ball and Dickwella simply pulled it behind for six runs. The ball sailed over the fine leg region and right into the stands. Superb start this!

FOUR! Dickwella joins the party! The ball was on a good length on middle. Dickwella made room for himself by moving towards the leg side and cut the ball through the point region for the boundary. Pressure on bowler straightaway!
FOUR! Full on off and this time Gunathalika lofts it over mid off. Gunathilaka looks dangerous as he is getting into the groove now. The ball went right off the middle of the bat there.
Full on off, driven to mid off.
Outside off this time, Gunathilaka plays it straight to point.
Goes over the mid-wicket region this time. Another full length ball and the batsman flicked it over mid-wicket for three runs. Good chase by the fielder to stop the boundary.

FOUR! Dickwella frees himself up with a fine boundary! That was full on off and he cleared the man at mid on with ease as the ball bounced on it's way past the ropes. Dickwella will be very happy with that!
Good length ball on middle, Dickwella defends it off the back foot.
Another solid punch off the back foot by Gunathilaka into the ground. Maiden over by Bumrah to start his spell.
Onto the pads again, this time slightly fuller. Gunathilaka flicks it to the leg side but straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery to defend this one.
Good length ball just outside off and Gunathilaka gets in a bit of trouble. He looks to play but seems to pull out at the last moment. The ball went just past his outside edge there.
Full on off, Gunathilaka drives it straight to covers.
Bowls this on the pads and on a good length. Gunathilaka looks to play but is struck on the thigh pad. No appeal as that was too high.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball.
Plays this one off the front foot and into the ground. Good start by B. Kumar.
Full on off, Dickwella drives it towards mid off.
Good length ball on the off stump. Punches it off the back foot towards mid off for a single.
Gets roight behind the the delivery and defends it back to the bowler.
Leaves the ball outside the off stump line this time.
Starts off with a good length ball on the off and middle line. Dickwella looks to defend but gets an inside edge which goes past the stumps and towards short fine leg.

The players are out in the middle. Niroshan Dickwella will take strike with Danushka Gunathilaka at the other end. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to open the bowling for India. He has two slips in place. Let's roll...
Pitch Report - The pitch looks flat, might get a little more moisture but teams won't mind as they like the ball coming on faster.

Upul Tharanga says he would have bowled first as well. Feels it is a very good wicket. When asked if the loss of the toss is affecting his team, he replies saying no. Also says they have to be patient and not make mistakes. Reckons that Shikhar Dhawan batted really well in the last game and he has been getting runs from the Test series. On the team news, he says there are three changes - Thisara Perera, Wanidu (Hasaranga) and Lakshan Sandakan are out. Dushmantha (Chameera), Akila Dananjaya and Milinda Siriwardana come in.

Virat Kohli says they're going to bowl first. Also adds that during the Test it (the pitch) was a bit slowish and hopes that it stays on the slower side. About the wicket, he says looking at it there's not much grass, dew factor could help the team batting second as the ball was coming nicely onto the bat when they were practicing yesterday evening. When asked about his 300th game, he says it has been 9 years and a huge honor and that he tries to give his best when he steps out on the field. On raising the bar, he mentions that Shikhar Dhawan has shown that and hopes he continues. On his team news, he says he is playing with the same team. Mentions that the experiments that he talked about was about giving the guys different roles. Ends by saying that there's still 3 games after this and giving chances can come later.
INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO BOWL FIRST!

Hello and welcome for the second ODI between Sri Lanka and India at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium. India won the first match convincingly and have a chance to go two up in the 5-match series. The weather forecast for the rest of the day is pretty positive and hopefully nothing untoward happens. Sri Lanka will be all fired up after the recent loss so this is going to be feisty affair for sure. Stay tuned as the toss is coming up in a bit!
